name: kwento-kilabot
description: Kwento: Kilabot Tagalog horror Reels/Shorts — off-screen narrator, nobody on screen ever shown speaking, foggy-night eerie Filipino look, vertical.
base_look: Foggy night in a Philippine town, sodium-vapour streetlight haze, handheld 35mm look, muted palette, fine film grain.
closing: Clean frame, free of subtitles, captions, watermarks and logos.
visual_rules: The narrator is off-screen in every clip. A visible person is always framed from behind, in silhouette, or by their hands; faces are never shown. This is stricter than the generic rule because any lip movement fails the QA check.
Foggy night and an eerie, specific Filipino setting in every clip; nothing bright, clean or cartoonish.
Recurring figures and places use a locked Look anchor, pasted verbatim into every prompt where they appear.
Avoid readable signs, close-ups of crowds and many hands; show one slow detail instead.
